title: Woman Attempts to Save Boyfriend From Arrest & Faces the Consequences!
description:
On April 2nd, 2023, officers in Florida received a call from staff at a local sports bar reporting a fight in the parking lot. Upon arrival, officers located a man and woman suspected to be a part of the fight. Both suspects appeared heavily intoxicated. While speaking to both the man and woman, the situation escalated when another male, also intoxicated, approached an officer in an aggressive manner, pointing his finger in the officer’s face. Despite being given instructions to step back, he continued to confront officers, leading officers to detain him as he resisted. 

While detaining the suspect, the woman began yelling, placing herself between officers attempting to detain the suspect. After eventually placing the male suspect in handcuffs, the officer began placing the woman under arrest as she resisted officers. Both suspects resisted and kicked officers while being escorted to the patrol cars. The female suspect was eventually placed in the patrol car after multiple refusals to enter the patrol car. Both suspects were then transported to jail. 

The female suspect was charged with Battery on an Officer, Resisting an Officer with Violence, Disorderly Intoxication, and Obstructing Justice. 
The male suspect was charged with Aggravated Battery on an Officer, Resisting an Officer with Violence, Disorderly Intoxication, Battery On an Officer Firefighter, Emt, Etc.
